runtimeArgs:
import http.server, threading, functools
H = functools.partial(http.server.SimpleHTTPRequestHandler, directory='.')
servers = [http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer(('0.0.0.0', p), H) for p in (8742, 8744)]
[threading.Thread(target=s.serve_forever, daemon=True).start() for s in servers[1:]]
servers[0].serve_forever()
